parsed.name: VISA通信传输层
parsed.description: 基于 pyVISA 的通用 VISA 通信软件组件，用于通过 GPIB、RS232、USB 或以太网与实验仪器建立会话并收发数据。本身不是具体的物理实验设备，而是面向多种仪器的通信接口层。
parsed.description_en: A generic VISA communication software component based on pyVISA, used to open sessions and exchange data with laboratory instruments over GPIB, RS232, USB, or Ethernet. It is not a specific physical lab device, but a communication layer for many kinds of instruments.

actions.description: 初始化 VISA 通信会话并打开资源连接。

actions.description_en: Send a query command and read the response.
